title: Institutions, Comparative Advantage, and the Environment
abstract: This paper proposes that strong financial, judicial, and labor market institutions provide comparative advantage in clean industries, and thereby improve a country's environmental quality. Five complementary tests support this hypothesis. First, industries that depend on institutions are disproportionately clean. Second, strong institutions increase relative exports in clean industries, even conditional on environmental regulation and factor endowments. Third, an industry's complexity helps explain the link between institutions and clean goods. Fourth, a quantitative general equilibrium model indicates that strengthening a country's institutions decreases its pollution through relocating dirty industries abroad, though increases pollution in other countries. Fifth, cross-country differences in the composition of output between clean and dirty industries explain more of the global distribution of emissions than differences in the techniques used for production do. The comparative advantage that strong institutions provide in clean industries gives one under-explored reason why developing countries have relatively high pollution levels.
abstract_zh: 本文提出，强大的金融、司法和劳动力市场制度会在清洁产业中形成比较优势，从而改善一个国家的环境质量。五项相互补充的检验支持这一假说。第一，依赖制度的产业明显更为清洁。第二，即使在控制环境监管和要素禀赋之后，强大的制度仍会提高清洁产业的相对出口。第三，产业的复杂性有助于解释制度与清洁商品之间的联系。第四，一个定量一般均衡模型表明，加强一国制度会通过将污染产业转移至国外而降低本国污染，但会增加其他国家的污染。第五，清洁与肮脏产业之间产出构成的跨国差异，比生产技术的差异更能解释全球排放的分布。强大的制度在清洁产业中所提供的比较优势，为发展中国家污染水平相对较高提供了一个尚未得到充分探讨的原因。

title: Is Air Pollution Regulation Too Lenient? Evidence from US Offset Markets
abstract: This paper describes a framework to estimate the marginal cost of air pollution regulation, then applies it to assess whether a large set of existing U.S. air pollution regulations have marginal benefits exceeding their marginal costs. The approach utilizes an important yet under-explored provision of the Clean Air Act requiring new or expanding plants to pay incumbents in the same or neighboring counties to reduce their pollution emissions. These “offset” regulations create several hundred decentralized, local markets for pollution that differ by pollutant and location. Economic theory and empirical tests suggest these market prices reveal information about the marginal cost of abatement for new or expanding firms. We compare estimates of the marginal benefit of abatement from leading air quality models to offset prices. We find that, for most regions and pollutants, the marginal benefits of pollution abatement exceed mean offset prices more than ten-fold. In at least one market, however, estimated marginal benefits are below offset prices.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个估计空气污染监管边际成本的框架，并以此评估美国现行的大量空气污染监管是否具有超过其边际成本的边际收益。该方法利用了《清洁空气法》中一项重要但尚未被充分探讨的条款：该条款要求新建或扩建的工厂向同一县或邻近县的现有企业支付费用，以促使其减少污染排放。这些“抵消”（offset）监管在不同污染物和地点之间形成了数百个分散的地方性污染权市场。经济理论与实证检验表明，这些市场价格揭示了新建或扩建企业的减排边际成本信息。我们将主流空气质量模型所给出的减排边际收益估计，与抵消价格进行比较。我们发现，对于大多数地区和污染物而言，污染减排的边际收益超过平均抵消价格十倍以上。然而，在至少一个市场中，估计的边际收益低于抵消价格。

title: Spatial Environmental Economics
venue: Handbook of Regional and Urban Economics
abstract: How do environmental goods and policies shape spatial patterns of economic activity? How will climate change modify these impacts over the coming decades? How do agglomeration, commuting, and other spatial forces and policies affect environmental quality? We distill theoretical and empirical research linking urban, regional, and spatial economics to the environment. We present stylized facts on spatial environmental economics, describe insights from canonical environmental models and spatial models, and discuss the building blocks for papers and the research frontier in enviro-spatial economics. Most enviro-spatial research remains bifurcated into either primarily environmental or spatial papers. Research is only beginning to realize potential insights from more closely combining spatial and environmental approaches. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 环境产品与政策如何塑造经济活动的空间格局？未来几十年气候变化将如何改变这些影响？集聚效应、通勤及其他空间力量和政策又如何影响环境质量？我们提炼了将城市、区域与空间经济学和环境相联系的理论与实证研究。我们提出了空间环境经济学的典型事实，阐述了经典环境模型与空间模型的启示，并讨论了环境—空间经济学论文的构成要素与研究前沿。大多数环境—空间研究仍然分化为主要偏向环境或主要偏向空间的论文。只有在更紧密地结合空间与环境视角之后，相关研究才刚刚开始发掘其潜在洞见。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Do Earmarks Target Low-Income and Minority Communities? Evidence from US Drinking Water
abstract: The quality and inequality of US drinking water investments have gained attention after recent environmental disasters in Flint, Michigan, and elsewhere. We compare the targeting of subsidized loans provided through the Safe Drinking Water Act with the targeting of congressional drinking water earmarks (“pork barrel” spending). Earmarks are critiqued for potentially privileging wealthier and politically connected communities. We find that earmarks target Black, Hispanic, and low-income communities, partly due to targeting water systems serving large populations. Earmark and loan targeting differ across all demographics we analyze. Compared to loans, earmarks disproportionately target Hispanic but not Black or low-income communities.
abstract_zh: 美国饮用水投资的质量与不平等问题，在密歇根州弗林特市及其他地方发生环境灾难后受到关注。我们比较了《安全饮用水法》提供的补贴贷款与国会饮用水专项拨款（“分肥式”支出）的分配对象。专项拨款因可能偏向较富裕且有政治关联的社区而受到批评。我们发现，专项拨款的对象包括黑人、西班牙裔和低收入社区，部分原因在于其瞄准了服务大量人口的供水系统。专项拨款与贷款在我们分析的所有人口特征上都存在差异。与贷款相比，专项拨款不成比例地瞄准西班牙裔社区，但并未如此瞄准黑人或低收入社区。

title: Machine Learning Predicts Which Rivers, Streams, and Wetlands the Clean Water Act Regulates
abstract: We assess which waters the Clean Water Act protects and how Supreme Court and White House rules change this regulation. We train a deep learning model using aerial imagery and geophysical data to predict 150,000 jurisdictional determinations from the Army Corps of Engineers, each deciding regulation for one water resource. Under a 2006 Supreme Court ruling, the Clean Water Act protects two-thirds of US streams and more than half of wetlands; under a 2020 White House rule, it protects less than half of streams and a fourth of wetlands, implying deregulation of 690,000 stream miles, 35 million wetland acres, and 30% of waters around drinking-water sources. Our framework can support permitting, policy design, and use of machine learning in regulatory implementation problems.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了《清洁水法》保护哪些水体，以及最高法院裁决和白宫规则如何改变这一监管。我们利用航拍影像和地球物理数据训练了一个深度学习模型，以预测美国陆军工程兵团作出的15万份管辖权认定，每份认定都决定了对一处水资源的监管。根据2006年最高法院的裁决，《清洁水法》保护美国三分之二的溪流和一半以上的湿地；根据2020年白宫规则，它保护的溪流不足一半，湿地仅占四分之一，这意味着将放松管制69万英里溪流、3500万英亩湿地，以及饮用水源周边30%的水体。我们的框架可以支持许可审批、政策设计，以及机器学习在监管执行问题中的应用。

title: Regulating Untaxable Externalities: Are Vehicle Air Pollution Standards Effective and Efficient?
abstract: The world has 1.4 billion passenger vehicles. How should governments regulate their air pollution emissions? A Pigouvian tax is technologically infeasible. Most countries instead rely on exhaust standards that limit air pollution emissions per mile for new vehicles. We assess the effectiveness and efficiency of these standards, which are the centerpiece of US Clean Air Act regulation of transportation, and counterfactual policies. We show that the air pollution emissions per mile of new US vehicles has fallen spectacularly, by over 99 percent, since standards began in 1967. Several research designs with a half century of data suggest that exhaust standards have caused most of this decline. Yet exhaust standards are not cost-effective in part because they fail to encourage scrap of older vehicles, which account for the majority of emissions. To study counterfactual policies, we develop an analytical and a quantitative model of the vehicle fleet. Analysis of these models suggests that tighter exhaust standards increase social welfare and that increasing registration fees on dirty vehicles yields even larger gains by accelerating scrap, though both reforms have complex effects on inequality.
abstract_zh: 全球有14亿辆乘用车。政府应如何监管其空气污染排放？庇古税在技术上不可行。大多数国家转而依赖尾气标准，即限制新车每英里的空气污染排放量。我们评估了这些标准的有效性和效率，它们是美国《清洁空气法》对交通运输实施监管的核心，同时也评估了若干反事实政策。我们表明，自1967年标准实施以来，美国新车每英里的空气污染排放量已大幅下降，降幅超过99%。利用半个世纪数据的若干研究设计表明，尾气标准是这一下降的主要原因。然而，尾气标准并不具备成本效益，部分原因在于它未能激励淘汰老旧车辆，而老旧车辆贡献了大部分排放。为研究反事实政策，我们构建了车队的解析模型和定量模型。对这些模型的分析表明，更严格的尾气标准会提高社会福利；而提高高排放车辆的登记费，则可通过加速报废带来更大的收益，尽管这两项改革对不平等都有复杂的影响。

title: Globalization and the Environment
abstract: Fears that globalization necessarily hurts the environment are not well-founded.A survey reveals little statistical evidence, on average across countries, that openness to international trade undermines national attempts at environmental regulation through a "race to the bottom" effect. If anything, favorable "gains from trade" effects dominate on average, for measures of air pollution such as SO 2 concentrations. Perceptions that WTO panel rulings have interfered with the ability of individual countries to pursue environmental goals are also poorly informed. Recent rulings have in fact confirmed that countries can enact environmental measures, even if they affect trade and even if they concern others' Processes and Production Methods (PPMs), provided the measures do not discriminate among producer countries. People care about both the environment and the economy. As real incomes rise, their demand for environmental quality rises. This translates into environmental progress under the right conditions --democracy, effective regulation, and externalities that are largely confined within national borders and are therefore amenable to national regulation. Increasingly, however, environmental problems spill across borders. Global externalities include climate change and ozone depletion. Economic growth alone will not address such problems, in a system where each country acts individually, due to the free rider problem. Multilateral institutions are needed, and national sovereignty is the obstacle, not the other way around.
abstract_zh: 认为全球化必然损害环境的担忧缺乏充分依据。一项调查显示，平均而言，跨国数据中几乎没有统计证据表明，国际贸易的开放会通过“逐底竞争”效应削弱各国的环境监管尝试。若有的话，就二氧化硫浓度等空气污染指标而言，有利的“贸易收益”效应平均占据主导。人们认为世界贸易组织（WTO）专家组裁决干扰了各国追求环境目标能力的看法，同样缺乏充分依据。事实上，近期的裁决已确认，各国可以颁布环境措施，即使这些措施影响贸易，甚至即使它们涉及他国的生产工艺与生产方法（PPMs），只要这些措施不在生产国之间进行歧视。人们既关心环境，也关心经济。随着实际收入的提高，他们对环境质量的需求也随之上升。在适当的条件下——民主制度、有效的监管，以及大体限于国界之内、因而适于国内监管的外部性——这将转化为环境进步。然而，环境问题日益跨越国界。全球性外部性包括气候变化和臭氧层破坏。在各国各自行动的体系中，由于搭便车问题，仅靠经济增长无法解决此类问题。需要多边机构，而障碍在于国家主权，而非相反。

title: Pollution Trends and US Environmental Policy: Lessons from the Last Half Century
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article proposes and evaluates four hypotheses about US pollution and environmental policy over the last half century. First, air and water pollution have declined substantially, although greenhouse gas emissions have not. Second, environmental policy explains a large share of these trends. Third, much of the regulation of air and drinking water pollution has benefits that exceed costs, although the evidence for surface water pollution regulation is less clear. Fourth, while the distribution of pollution across social groups is unequal, market-based environmental policies and command-and-control policies do not appear to produce systematically different distributions of environmental outcomes. I also discuss recent innovations in methods and data that can be used to evaluate pollution trends and policies, including the increased use of environmental administrative data, statistical cost-benefit comparisons, analysis of previously understudied policies, more sophisticated analyses of pollution transport, micro-macro frameworks, and a focus on the distribution of environmental outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文提出并评估了关于过去半个世纪美国污染与环境政策的四个假说。第一，空气和水污染已大幅下降，但温室气体排放并未下降。第二，环境政策解释了这些趋势的很大一部分。第三，对空气和饮用水污染的大部分监管，其收益超过成本，尽管地表水污染监管的证据尚不够清晰。第四，尽管污染在不同社会群体之间的分布并不平等，但以市场为基础的环境政策与命令—控制型政策，似乎并不会系统性地产生不同的环境结果分布。我还讨论了可用于评估污染趋势与政策的方法和数据方面的近期创新，包括更多地使用环境行政数据、统计成本收益比较、对以往研究不足的政策进行分析、对污染传输进行更精细的分析、微观—宏观框架，以及对环境结果分布的关注。

title: The Evolution of the Waters of the United States and the Role of Economics
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: A water rule that turns a blind eye to transboundary pollution
The Environmental Bias of Trade Policy
abstract: This article describes a new fact, then analyzes its causes and consequences: in most countries, import tariffs and nontariff barriers are substantially lower on dirty than on clean industries, where an industry’s “dirtiness” is defined as its carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions per dollar of output. This difference in trade policy creates a global implicit subsidy to CO2 emissions in internationally traded goods and contributes to climate change. This global implicit subsidy to CO2 emissions totals several hundred billion dollars annually. The greater protection of downstream industries, which are relatively clean, substantially accounts for this pattern. The downstream pattern can be explained by theories where industries lobby for low tariffs on their inputs but final consumers are poorly organized. A quantitative general equilibrium model suggests that if countries applied similar trade policies to clean and dirty goods, global CO2 emissions would decrease and global real income would change little.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个新事实，并分析其成因与后果：在大多数国家，进口关税和非关税壁垒对“肮脏”行业的保护程度远低于“清洁”行业，其中行业的“肮脏程度”定义为每单位产出所排放的二氧化碳（CO2）量。这种贸易政策上的差异，在国际贸易商品中形成了对CO2排放的全球性隐性补贴，并助长了气候变化。这种对CO2排放的全球隐性补贴每年合计达数千亿美元。对相对清洁的下游行业给予更多保护，在很大程度上导致了这一格局。这种下游格局可以由以下理论解释：各行业游说政府对其投入品实施低关税，而最终消费者的组织性较差。一个定量一般均衡模型表明，若各国对清洁与肮脏商品采取相似的贸易政策，全球CO2排放将会下降，而全球实际收入的变化则很小。

title: Where is Pollution Moving? Environmental Markets and Environmental Justice
abstract: Do US air pollution offset markets disproportionately relocate pollution to or from low-income or minority communities? Concerns about an equal distribution of environmental quality across communities--environmental justice--have growing policy influence. We relate prices and quantities of offset transactions to the demographics of the communities surrounding polluting plants. We find little association of offset prices or offset-induced movements in pollution with the share of a community that is Black or Hispanic or with mean household income. This analysis of 12 prominent offset markets suggests that they do not substantially increase or decrease the equity of environmental outcomes.
abstract_zh: 美国的空气污染抵消市场是否不成比例地将污染转移到低收入社区或少数族裔社区，或将污染从这些社区转出？对于环境质量在不同社区之间公平分配——即环境正义——的关切，正日益对政策产生影响。我们将抵消交易的价格和数量，与污染工厂周边社区的人口特征联系起来。我们发现，抵消价格或抵消所引起的污染转移，与社区中黑人或西班牙裔人口比例以及平均家庭收入之间几乎没有关联。对12个主要抵消市场的分析表明，它们并未显著提高或降低环境结果的公平性。

title: Energy Cost Pass-Through in U.S. Manufacturing: Estimates and Implications for Carbon Taxes
abstract: We study how changes in energy input costs for U.S. manufacturers affect the relative welfare of manufacturing producers and consumers (i.e., incidence).We also develop a methodology to estimate the incidence of input taxes which accounts for incomplete pass-through, imperfect competition, and substitution amongst inputs. For the several industries we study, 70 percent of energy price-driven changes in input costs get passed through to consumers in the short-to medium-run. The share of the welfare cost that consumers bear is 25-75 percent smaller (and the share producers bear is larger) than models featuring complete pass-through and perfect competition would suggest.
abstract_zh: 我们研究美国制造商能源投入成本的变化，如何影响制造业生产者与消费者的相对福利（即税负归宿）。我们还开发了一种方法，用以估计投入税的归宿，该方法考虑了不完全传导、不完全竞争以及投入品之间的替代。在我们研究的几个行业中，能源价格变动所引起的投入成本变化，在短期至中期内有70%会传导给消费者。消费者承担的福利成本份额，比假设完全传导与完全竞争的模型所显示的要小25%至75%（而生产者承担的份额则更大）。

title: Consequences of the Clean Water Act and the Demand for Water Quality
abstract: Since the 1972 U.S. Clean Water Act, government and industry have invested over |${\$}$|1 trillion to abate water pollution, or |${\$}$|100 per person-year. Over half of U.S. stream and river miles, however, still violate pollution standards. We use the most comprehensive set of files ever compiled on water pollution and its determinants, including 50 million pollution readings from 240,000 monitoring sites and a network model of all U.S. rivers, to study water pollution’s trends, causes, and welfare consequences. We have three main findings. First, water pollution concentrations have fallen substantially. Between 1972 and 2001, for example, the share of waters safe for fishing grew by 12 percentage points. Second, the Clean Water Act’s grants to municipal wastewater treatment plants, which account for |${\$}$|650 billion in expenditure, caused some of these declines. Through these grants, it cost around |${\$}$|1.5 million (2014 dollars) to make one river-mile fishable for a year. We find little displacement of municipal expenditure due to a federal grant. Third, the grants’ estimated effects on housing values are smaller than the grants’ costs; we carefully discuss welfare implications.
abstract_zh: 自1972年美国《清洁水法》颁布以来，政府和工业界已投入超过1万亿美元用于治理水污染，即每人每年约100美元。然而，美国仍有一半以上的溪流和河流里程违反污染标准。我们利用有史以来为水污染及其决定因素汇编的最全面文件（包括来自24万个监测点的5000万条污染读数，以及全美所有河流的网络模型），研究水污染的趋势、成因和福利后果。我们有三项主要发现。第一，水体污染浓度大幅下降。例如，1972年至2001年间，适合捕鱼的水体比例提高了12个百分点。第二，《清洁水法》对市政污水处理厂的拨款（其支出总额达6500亿美元）促成了部分降幅。通过这些拨款，使一英里河流在一年内达到可捕鱼标准的成本约为150万美元（2014年美元）。我们发现，联邦拨款导致的市政支出挤出效应很小。第三，拨款对住房价值的估计效应小于拨款成本；我们对福利含义进行了细致讨论。

title: The Low but Uncertain Measured Benefits of US Water Quality Policy
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: US investment to decrease pollution in rivers, lakes, and other surface waters has exceeded $1.9 trillion since 1960, and has also exceeded the cost of most other US environmental initiatives. These investments come both from the 1972 Clean Water Act and the largely voluntary efforts to control pollution from agriculture and urban runoff. This paper reviews the methods and conclusions of about 20 recent evaluations of these policies. Surprisingly, most analyses estimate that these policies’ benefits are much smaller than their costs; the benefit–cost ratio from the median study is 0.37. However, existing evidence is limited and undercounts many types of benefits. We conclude that it is unclear whether many of these regulations truly fail a benefit–cost test or whether existing evidence understates their net benefits; we also describe specific questions that when answered would help eliminate this uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 自1960年以来，美国用于减少河流、湖泊及其他地表水污染的投资已超过1.9万亿美元，也超过了美国大多数其他环境举措的成本。这些投资既来自1972年《清洁水法》，也来自主要为自愿性质的农业及城市径流污染控制努力。本文回顾了约20项近期针对这些政策所作评估的方法与结论。令人意外的是，大多数分析估计，这些政策的收益远小于其成本；中位数研究的收益—成本比仅为0.37。然而，现有证据十分有限，且低估了许多类型的收益。我们的结论是：目前尚不清楚这些法规中的许多是否真的未能通过收益—成本检验，抑或现有证据低估了其净收益；我们也描述了若能回答便有助于消除这一不确定性的具体问题。

title: US Water Pollution Regulation over the Last Half Century: Burning Waters to Crystal Springs?
abstract: In the half century since the founding of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the U.S. has spent nearly $5 trillion ($2017) to provide cleaner rivers, lakes, and drinking water, or annual spending of 0.8 percent of U.S. GDP in most years. Yet over half of rivers and substantial shares of drinking water systems violate standards, and polls for decades have listed water pollution as Americans’ number one environmental concern. We assess the history, effectiveness, and efficiency of the Clean Water Act and Safe Drinking Water Act, and obtain four main conclusions. First, water pollution has fallen since these laws, in part due to their interventions. Second, investments made under these laws could be more costeffective. Third, most recent studies estimate benefits of cleaning up pollution in rivers and lakes which are much less than their costs. Either these analyses systematically understate the value of these investments or these investments are inefficient. Analysis finds more positive net benefits of drinking water quality investments. Fourth, economic research and teaching on water pollution is surprisingly uncommon, as measured by samples of publications, conference presentations, or textbooks.
abstract_zh: 自美国环境保护署成立以来的半个世纪里，美国已花费近5万亿美元（2017年美元）以提供更清洁的河流、湖泊和饮用水，即多数年份年均支出占美国GDP的0.8%。然而，超过一半的河流以及相当比例的饮用水系统仍不达标，且数十年来的民意调查均将水污染列为美国人最关心的环境问题之首。我们评估了《清洁水法》和《安全饮用水法》的历史、有效性和效率，得出四点主要结论。第一，自这些法律实施以来，水污染有所下降，部分原因在于这些法律的干预。第二，根据这些法律所作的投资本可更具成本效益。第三，近期大多数研究估计，清理河流和湖泊污染的收益远小于其成本。要么这些分析系统性地低估了这些投资的价值，要么这些投资本身是低效的。分析发现，饮用水质量投资的净收益则更为正面。第四，根据出版物样本、学术会议报告或教科书统计，水污染的经济学研究与教学出人意料地少见。

title: Regulating Mismeasured Pollution: Implications of Firm Heterogeneity for Environmental Policy
abstract: This paper provides the first estimates of within-industry heterogeneity in energy and CO2 productivity for the entire U.S. manufacturing sector. We measure energy and CO2 productivity as output per dollar energy input or per ton CO2 emitted. Three findings emerge. First, within narrowly defined industries, heterogeneity in energy and CO2 productivity across plants is enormous. Second, heterogeneity in energy and CO2 productivity exceeds heterogeneity in most other productivity measures, like labor or total factor productivity. Third, heterogeneity in energy and CO2 productivity has important implications for environmental policies targeting industries rather than plants, including technology standards and carbon border adjustments.
abstract_zh: 本文首次估计了美国整个制造业部门内部，能源和CO2生产率的行业内异质性。我们将能源和CO2生产率分别衡量为每美元能源投入的产出，或每吨CO2排放的产出。研究得出三点发现。第一，在狭义定义的行业内部，各工厂之间能源和CO2生产率的异质性非常巨大。第二，能源和CO2生产率的异质性超过了大多数其他生产率指标（如劳动生产率或全要素生产率）的异质性。第三，能源和CO2生产率的异质性对以行业而非工厂为目标的环境政策具有重要含义，包括技术标准和碳边境调节。

title: Why is Pollution from U.S. Manufacturing Declining? The Roles of Environmental Regulation, Productivity, and Trade
abstract: Between 1990 and 2008, air pollution emissions from U.S. manufacturing fell by 60 percent despite a substantial increase in manufacturing output. We show that these emissions reductions are primarily driven by within-product changes in emissions intensity rather than changes in output or in the composition of products produced. We then develop and estimate a quantitative model linking trade with the environment to better understand the economic forces driving these changes. Our estimates suggest that the implicit pollution tax that manufacturers face doubled between 1990 and 2008. These changes in environmental regulation, rather than changes in productivity and trade, account for most of the emissions reductions.
abstract_zh: 1990年至2008年间，尽管美国制造业产出大幅增长，但其空气污染排放仍下降了60%。我们表明，这些减排主要源于同一产品内部排放强度的变化，而非产出规模或产品构成的变化。随后，我们构建并估计了一个将贸易与环境联系起来的定量模型，以更好地理解驱动这些变化的经济力量。我们的估计表明，1990年至2008年间，制造商面临的隐性污染税翻了一番。正是环境监管的这些变化，而非生产率与贸易的变化，解释了大部分的减排。

title: Defensive Investments and the Demand for Air Quality: Evidence from the NOx Budget Program
abstract: The demand for air quality depends on health impacts and defensive investments, but little research assesses the empirical importance of defenses. A rich quasi-experiment suggests that the Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) Budget Program (NBP), a cap-and-trade market, decreased NOx emissions, ambient ozone concentrations, pharmaceutical expenditures, and mortality rates. The annual reductions in pharmaceutical purchases, a key defensive investment, and mortality are valued at about $800 million and $1.3 billion, respectively, suggesting that defenses are over one-third of willingness-to-pay for reductions in NOx emissions. Further, estimates indicate that the NBP's benefits easily exceed its costs and that NOx reductions have substantial benefits. (JEL I12, Q51, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 对空气质量的需求取决于健康影响和防御性投资，但很少有研究评估防御性投资的实证重要性。一项丰富的准实验表明，氮氧化物（NOx）预算计划（NBP）——一个总量控制与交易市场——降低了NOx排放、近地面臭氧浓度、药品支出和死亡率。作为关键防御性投资的药品购买量与死亡率的年度减少，分别估值约为8亿美元和13亿美元，这表明防御性投资占减少NOx排放的支付意愿的三分之一以上。此外，估计结果显示，NBP的收益轻松超过其成本，且NOx减排具有可观的收益。（JEL分类号：I12, Q51, Q53, Q58）

title: Adapting to Climate Change: The Remarkable Decline in the U.S. Temperature-Mortality Relationship Over the 20th Century
abstract: This paper examines the temperature-mortality relationship over the course of the 20th century US both for its own interest and to identify potentially useful adaptations for coming decades. There are three primary findings. First, the mortality impact of days with mean temperature exceeding 80° F declined by 75%. Almost the entire decline occurred after 1960. Second, the diffusion of residential air conditioning (AC) explains essentially the entire decline in hot day related fatalities. Third, using Dubin-McFadden’s discrete-continuous model, the present value of US consumer surplus from the introduction of residential AC is estimated to be $85 to $188 billion ($2012).
abstract_zh: 本文考察了20世纪美国的温度与死亡率关系，既出于其本身的兴趣，也为了识别未来几十年可能有用的适应措施。主要有三项发现。第一，平均气温超过80华氏度的日子对死亡率的影响下降了75%，且几乎全部下降都发生在1960年之后。第二，住宅空调（AC）的普及基本解释了与炎热天气相关的死亡人数的全部下降。第三，运用Dubin–McFadden的离散—连续模型，我们估计引入住宅空调所带来的美国消费者剩余现值为850亿至1880亿美元（按2012年美元计）。

title: Trade Costs, CO2, and the Environment
Convergence in Adaptation to Climate Change: Evidence from High Temperatures and Mortality, 1900-2004
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: This paper combines panel data on monthly mortality rates of US states and daily temperature variables for over a century (1900-2004) to explore the regional evolution of the temperature-mortality relationship and documents two key findings. First, the impact of extreme heat on mortality is notably smaller in states that more frequently experience extreme heat. Second, the difference in the heat-mortality relationship between hot and cold states declined over 1900-2004, though it persisted through 2004. Continuing differences in the mortality consequences of hot days suggests that health motivated adaptation to climate change may be slow and costly around the world.
abstract_zh: 本文将美国各州1900至2004年间超过一个世纪的月度死亡率面板数据，与逐日温度变量相结合，以探讨温度与死亡率关系的区域演变，并记录了两项关键发现。第一，在更频繁经历极端高温的州，极端高温对死亡率的影响明显更小。第二，炎热州与寒冷州之间在高温—死亡率关系上的差异，在1900至2004年间有所下降，但直至2004年仍然存在。炎热日子对死亡率影响的持续差异表明，出于健康动机的气候变化适应在全球范围内可能进展缓慢且成本高昂。

title: Globalization and the Role of Public Transfers in Redistributing Income in Latin America and the Caribbean
Community-Based Production of Open-Source Software: What do we Know About the Developers who Participate?
The Benefits of Delayed Primary School Enrollment: Discontinuity Estimates using Exact Birthdates
Water Works: Causes and Consequences of Safe Drinking Water in America
The Effects of "Buy American": Electric Vehicles and the Inflation Reduction Act
abstract: We provide the first ex post microeconomic welfare analysis of the electric vehicle (EV) tax credits in the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA).Relative to pre-IRA policy, the credits generated $1.96 in domestic benefits per dollar of government spending, with taxpayer cost of $36,500 per additional EV.Relative to having no EV credits, they yielded $1.11 in domestic benefits per dollar of government spending.A leasing loophole that sidestepped domestic content rules created negative domestic benefits.A prominent example of green industrial policy, the credits harmed foreign countries by shifting surplus to domestic producers and helped them by decreasing CO emissions.
abstract_zh: 我们首次对《通胀削减法案》（IRA）中的电动汽车（EV）税收抵免政策进行了事后微观经济福利分析。相较于《通胀削减法案》实施之前的政策，这些抵免每花费一美元政府支出即产生1.96美元的国内收益，每增加一辆电动汽车的纳税人成本为36500美元。相较于不存在电动汽车抵免的情形，它们每花费一美元政府支出产生1.11美元的国内收益。一项规避国内含量规则的租赁漏洞产生了负的国内收益。作为绿色产业政策的典型例子，这些抵免通过将剩余转移给国内生产者而损害了外国，但也因减少了CO排放而对外国有所助益。

title: Are We Consuming Too Much Groundwater?
abstract: We study the optimality of human groundwater extraction from many of the world’s 3,400 aquifers, where institutional or market failures may produce nonoptimal extraction decisions. We use remote sensing and economic data to estimate a dynamic model of water extraction for each aquifer, recover the discount factor that rationalizes observed groundwater extraction, and compare it against Ramsey and market benchmarks. Three- to four-fifths of aquifers are extracted more rapidly than is optimal, decreasing aquifer present value by several percent, and creating trillions of dollars in present value welfare losses. Policies that guarantee users constant water quantities indefinitely, through subsidies or prior appropriation, or policy rules that fully discount future extraction, generate larger welfare costs. A sustainable extraction path that maintains current fill forever generates meaningfully lower welfare than the optimal extraction path, because most aquifer stocks are already inefficiently low.
abstract_zh: 我们研究全球约3,400个含水层中人类地下水开采的最优性，其中制度或市场失灵可能导致非最优的开采决策。我们利用遥感和经济数据，为每个含水层估计一个动态的取水模型，恢复能够合理解释观测到的地下水开采行为的贴现因子，并将其与拉姆齐基准及市场基准进行比较。五分之三至五分之四的含水层开采速度快于最优水平，使含水层现值减少数个百分点，并造成数万亿美元的现值福利损失。通过补贴或先占用水权来无限期保证用户获得恒定水量的政策，或完全贴现未来开采量的政策规则，将产生更大的福利成本。维持当前蓄水量不变的可持续开采路径，所产生的福利明显低于最优开采路径，因为大多数含水层的蓄水量本已低得缺乏效率。

title: Carbon Emissions in the Global Economy
Consequences of Land Use Regulation Under the Clean Water Act
Deep Learning Projects Jurisdiction of New and Proposed Clean Water Act Regulation
Understanding Support for Cost-Ineffective Environmental Policy Instruments
abstract: Many governments use environmental standards rather than more cost-effective market-based instruments like pollution taxes or cap-and-trade. We investigate whether and how economic literacy shapes voter support for cost-ineffective policy instruments. We compare the preferences and beliefs of a probability-based, representative sample of Americans to those of expert environmental economists, and we study the effects of educational videos designed to induce greater economic expertise. In the probability-based sample, respondents prefer the weakest environmental targets for consumer taxes and the strongest targets for standards, suggesting that policymakers face tradeoffs between policy stringency and cost-effectiveness. In contrast to expert environmental economists, these respondents believe that market-based instruments increase consumer energy bills more than standards do. Educational videos explaining pass-through and cost-effectiveness affect policy support and move beliefs in the probability-based sample closer to those of experts. To formally study the economic implications of these results, we develop a model of politically constrained policy design. Political constraints alone can lead market-based instruments to be set below the Pigouvian benchmark, while voters’ imperfect economic literacy can flip the politically constrained planner from choosing a market-based instrument to a less cost-effective standard. We conclude that misunderstanding economic principles is an important reason why voters support cost-ineffective policies. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 许多政府采用环境标准，而非成本效益更高的市场化工具，如污染税或总量控制与交易。我们研究经济素养是否以及如何影响选民对成本效益较低的政策工具的支持。我们比较了基于概率抽样的、具有代表性的美国人样本与环境经济学专家的偏好与信念，并研究了旨在提高经济专业知识的教育视频的效果。在基于概率抽样的样本中，受访者对消费者税偏好最弱的环境目标，而对标准则偏好最强的环境目标，这表明政策制定者面临政策严格程度与成本效益之间的权衡。与环境经济学专家不同，这些受访者认为，市场化工具比标准更会增加消费者的能源账单。解释传导与成本效益的教育视频，提高了政策支持度，并使基于概率抽样样本的信念更接近专家的信念。为正式研究这些结果的经济含义，我们构建了一个政治约束下政策设计的模型。仅政治约束就可能使市场化工具的设定低于庇古基准，而选民不完善的经济素养则可能使受政治约束的规划者从选择市场化工具转而选择成本效益更低的标准。我们的结论是，对经济原理的误解，是选民支持成本效益低下政策的一个重要原因。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。
